Defendant Shen Mou Jia (沈某甲) beats officer Zhang Mou Jia (张某甲) on the head with his fist to stop them from pulling his uncle. He later surrenders and confesses.

In Chinese criminal law, assault on law enforcement officers performing duties can be "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury) or "妨害公务罪" (obstructing official duties). The act is beating the officer's head, causing injury? Not specified injury severity. Could be "妨害公务罪" (obstructing public officials in the performance of their duties) under Article 277 of Criminal Law. Also "故意伤害罪" if injury. The fact says "用拳头殴打执法人员张某甲的头部". That is assault. Likely charge: "妨害公务罪". If injury, could be "故意伤害罪". Usually, beating a law enforcement officer is considered "妨害公务罪" if no serious injury. The law: Article 277: "阻碍国家机关工作人员依法执行职务的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役、管制或者罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑". If causing injury, may be "故意伤害罪" plus "妨害公务罪". The question: "这部分事实构成什么罪名？一行作答。" Likely they want "妨害公务罪".
